Compartment 4.17.0 expands Compartment into a versioned, encrypted Document Management System (DMS) inside the same `.vault` file, adds an optional cross-platform desktop GUI (`compartment gui`) across macOS, Windows, and Linux, and adds inline Document Search directly into the macOS menu bar app and its Windows/Linux tray and panel equivalents while keeping every existing control intact - 100% offline, with zero network calls of any kind and a portable, encrypted `.vault` file you own and can back up or copy anywhere, local disk, USB, NAS, or any cloud drive, like any other file.

## What's New

### Encrypted, Versioned Document Management System (DMS)
- **Documents strengthen core atomic memory without reducing it:** All existing memory guarantees remain untouched (200-char shape gate, facts vs. opinions, hybrid semantic + lexical + 1-hop graph search, single `.vault` file, zero plaintext on disk, zero new dependencies, and zero extra work on vaults with no documents).
- **Cryptographic grounding and automatic staleness detection:** Atomic memories (`memory_store`, `memory_store_many`) and relations (`memory_link`) can now reference `doc_id` and `doc_section`, pinning the exact document version they were derived from. Updating, archiving, or deleting a source document automatically flags older grounded memories `doc_stale: true` (and returns `affected_memory_ids` instead of silently deleting memories).
- **Per-document-version encryption and crypto-shred:** Every document version uses its own random 256-bit data key wrapped under the master key with dedicated AEAD labels (`compartment-doc-key:`, `compartment-doc-body:`, `compartment-doc-chunk:`), enabling permanent per-version or whole-document crypto-shred (`doc delete --shred`).
- **Stdlib-only multi-format extraction, chunking, patching, and diffs:** Extracts searchable text cleanly from Markdown, plain text, source code, HTML, `.docx`, `.odt`, `.pptx`, `.xlsx`, `.epub`, `.rtf`, and simple `.pdf` files with zero external dependencies. Includes Markdown outlines, targeted section/replace/append patching (`doc_patch`), unified diffs (`doc diff`), living memory compilation (`doc compile`), lossless multi-machine vault merge, JSONL (`--include-documents`), and filesystem import/export (`doc import`, `doc export`, `doc export-all`).
- **Non-crowding unified recall and 6 new MCP tools (20 total):** `memory_search` surfaces matching document excerpts in a dedicated `documents` array without displacing atomic `results`, and adds `doc_put`, `doc_patch`, `doc_get`, `doc_list`, `doc_search`, and `doc_delete` across MCP, CLI (`compartment doc ...`), Hermes plugin, and the local read-only dashboard.

### Optional Cross-Platform Desktop GUI (`compartment gui` / `compartment app`)
- **Full encrypted workspace with zero new dependencies and zero sockets:** Built on Python's standard-library `tkinter`/`ttk` for macOS, Windows, and Linux (works even under `--assert-offline`), with a 4-tab workspace for **Documents** (editor, outline, version history & unified diffs, grounded memories & inline staleness creator, file/folder import & export, archive/crypto-shred, memory compilation), **Memories** (hybrid search, recent, stale-only, source-document jumps), **Relations**, and **Vault & Agents** (live status, settings, agent connections, backups, merge, audit verify, selftest).
- **Live session & multi-process security:** Automatically drops the in-memory master key and returns to the Lock screen if locked externally (`compartment lock` or the top bar), and seamlessly reloads external agent/CLI vault writes without discarding unsaved edits.

### Top Bar App (macOS) & Windows/Linux Tray and Panel Upgrades
- **All existing options preserved + inline Document Search:** Keeps every existing toggle, Lock/Unlock, Create Vault, Back up/Merge, Change Password, Connect an Agent row, Last 5 Memories, Dashboard, Refresh, Quit, and Privacy link intact, while adding inline **Document Search** (read-only over `VaultView` with zero vault writes and zero idle RAM overhead), clickable in-panel **Document Preview**, and an **Open GUI** button across macOS menu bar, Windows notification tray, and Linux panel (plus `[Desktop Action gui]` in Linux's `.desktop` entry).

### macOS App Sandbox & Packaging Improvements
- Adds macOS App Sandbox and Mac App Store packaging support, in-app Privacy Policy link in the menu bar popover, and cross-platform CI stability fixes for Windows shared-memory teardown and macOS SDK 26 button layout.
